ENVO LV20 Electric Microcar | LSV, L6e and Neighbourhood Electric Vehicle
The ENVO LV20 is a compact electric microcar designed for neighbourhood travel, short-distance commuting, campuses, resorts, gated communities, industrial properties, and local commercial fleets. Depending on its configuration and regional approval, the LV20 can be developed as a low-speed vehicle, neighbourhood electric vehicle, LSV, or European L6e light quadricycle. Its small footprint makes parking and manoeuvring easier, while an enclosed or semi-enclosed cabin provides greater comfort and weather protection than an e-bike or open utility cart.
Accessories shown may be optional, not included in the base price, or unavailable for individual sale. Check the product configuration or contact us for details.
